Title: Public Preview: Hosted Agents in Foundry Agent Service

Body.Content: Hosted agents run in an isolated execution sandbox that provides a dedicated, secure runtime per agent session. Sessions start with a clean environment with no shared state between sessions, no cross-session data leakage, and strong compute boundaries between tenants.
